glosses: to fluctuate (to vary irregularly; to swing)
podlegać wahaniom; zmieniać się w sposób nieregularny lub zmienny; często się zmieniać

examples.text: One of them, at great Expence of Algebra, proves, that the Motes, which in Scotomias, we seem to have in our Eyes, are not real Bodies fluctuating in them.
I fluctuated between wishing he was back home and wishing I'd never met him.

glosses: To rise and fall as a wave; to be tossed up and down the waves.
Tossed up and down the waves.
